Courses in Accounting major

Select courses equivalent to 45 ECTS according to the plan below for a major in Accounting (ACC). Together with your master thesis (30ECTS), this constitutes your major.

Please note: All students starting in the autumn of 2024 and later are required to take at least 7,5 ECTS credits from the courses designated "Ethics, Responsibility and Sustainability" (ERS).
